heading.en: Solar Farm Fastener Procurement: Volume, Speed, and the Cost of a Wrong Bolt
heading.zh: 光伏电站紧固件采购：量、速度与选错螺栓的代价

body.en:
Utility-scale solar is a fastener business disguised as an energy business. A single project can consume hundreds of thousands of bolts, nuts, and clamps, and the mounting structure is assembled by crews who are paid for speed. That combination makes two things decisive: supply reliability and assembly consistency.

A bolt that arrives late stops a crew; a bolt that does not fit stops the same crew and also generates a change order. Procurement planning here is less about unit price than about protecting the installation schedule.
body.zh:
公用事业级光伏本质上是“伪装成能源生意的紧固件生意”。单个项目可能消耗几十万颗螺栓、螺母和压块，而支架由按速度计酬的施工队组装。这使两件事变得决定性：供货可靠性与装配一致性。

晚到的螺栓会让施工队停工；装不上的螺栓同样让施工队停工，还会产生变更单。这里的采购计划与其说在比单价，不如说在保护安装进度。

heading.en: The Bill of Materials Behind a Mounting Structure

body.en:
A typical fixed-tilt or tracker structure draws on a narrow set of items: foundation bolts and anchor assemblies, module clamps and mid-clamps, rail-to-purlin fasteners, and structural bolts for torque-tube connections. Grades cluster at 8.8 with hot-dip galvanizing as the default coating, and stainless where coastal exposure or specific module hardware requires it.

Because the item count is small and the volume is large, the risk is not variety — it is consistency. Bolts sourced from two production runs can differ in coating thickness and thread fit, and that difference shows up as stripped nuts in the field.
body.zh:
典型的固定支架或跟踪支架结构只用到很少的品类：基础螺栓与锚固组件、组件压块与中压块、导轨到檩条的紧固件，以及扭矩管连接的结构螺栓。等级集中在 8.8，热浸镀锌是默认镀层，沿海暴露或特定组件五金要求时用不锈钢。

因为品类少而量大，风险不在多样性，而在一致性。来自两个生产批次的螺栓可能在镀层厚度和螺纹配合上有差异，而这种差异在工地表现为螺母滑牙。

heading.en: Delivering to Site: The Sequence Problem

body.en:
Solar sites are built in blocks, and each block needs its fasteners before the module lift. Ship in block sequence with quantities kitted per block rather than delivering one enormous mixed container. Kitting costs a little at origin and saves a great deal at site, because sorting tens of thousands of mixed fasteners in the field costs crew hours that nobody budgets for.

Also plan for the tail. The last five percent of a fastener order is the part that always causes a scramble, so hold a defined buffer at the project warehouse rather than relying on a resupply that has to clear customs.
body.zh:
光伏现场是按区块建设的，每个区块在组件吊装前都要拿到自己的紧固件。要按区块顺序发运、按区块配齐数量，而不是一次性发一个巨大的混装柜。配装成本在起运地很小，在现场省下的却很多，因为现场从几万件混料里分拣要花掉没人预算过的工时。

还要为“尾部”做计划。订单最后 5% 永远是最容易出乱子的部分，因此要在项目仓库留出明确缓冲，而不是依赖需要清关的补货。

body.en:
Inspect at three points: coating thickness at origin, dimensional fit on a sample from each production lot, and torque behaviour during the first installation block. The third check is the useful one — it finds the combination of coating, lubricity, and thread tolerance that a dimensional report alone will miss.

Specify the torque values in writing and require the supplier to state the assumed lubricity, because the same bolt tightened dry and lubricated behaves differently and the field crew will not know which assumption you made.
body.zh:
在三个节点检验：起运地的镀层厚度、每个生产批次抽样做尺寸配合、以及首个安装区块的扭矩表现。第三项最有用——它能发现单纯的尺寸报告看不出来的镀层、润滑性与螺纹公差的组合问题。

扭矩值要书面规定，并要求供应商写明所假设的润滑状态，因为同一颗螺栓干拧和涂润滑剂的表现不同，现场施工队并不知道你按哪种假设定的扭矩。

body.en:
Unit price is a small part of the cost equation once installation speed is included. A cheaper bolt that needs rework, or that arrives in mixed cartons requiring site sorting, can cost more in labour than the entire price difference.

The practical approach is to price landed and kitted: include freight, coating verification, per-block kitting, and a buffer allowance in the comparison. That comparison usually favours the supplier who can guarantee consistency, and it is the only number that survives contact with a construction schedule.
body.zh:
一旦把安装速度算进来，单价在成本等式里只占很小一部分。需要返工的便宜螺栓，或者以混装纸箱到货、要在现场分拣的螺栓，其人工成本可能超过全部的价差。

可行的方法是按“到岸+配装”来比价：把运费、镀层验证、按区块配装和缓冲预留都计入比较。这样的比较通常偏向能保证一致性的供应商，而且这是唯一能经受施工进度检验的数字。

faq.q: Which fasteners dominate a solar mounting bill of materials?
faq.a: Foundation bolts and anchor assemblies, module clamps, rail-to-purlin fasteners, and structural bolts for torque-tube connections, mostly grade 8.8 with hot-dip galvanizing.

faq.q: Why does consistency matter more than variety?
faq.a: The item count is small but volumes are large. Bolts from different production runs can differ in coating thickness and thread fit, which shows up as stripped nuts during installation.

faq.q: Should fasteners be shipped kitted per block?
faq.a: Yes. Shipping in installation-block sequence with per-block kitting costs little at origin and avoids crew hours spent sorting mixed fasteners on site.

faq.q: What is the most useful inspection point?
faq.a: Torque behaviour during the first installation block. It reveals coating, lubricity, and thread tolerance combinations that dimensional reports alone cannot catch.
